games.title: VoidRush
games.subtitle: Swallow the whole map
games.description: Steer your hole and devour everything that fits — cars, houses, skyscrapers. Grow bigger than rival holes before the timer hits zero.

games.title: Crowd Clash Runner
games.subtitle: Grow your crowd, smash the gates
games.description: Steer your crowd through power gates, dodge hazards, grab crates, and race for the finish. Casual endless-runner energy with shop upgrades.

games.title: Drop & Fuse
games.subtitle: Match orbs. Chain merges. Don’t overflow.
games.description: Drop glowing orbs into the bin. Same sizes fuse into the next tier — chain big merges for high scores, but never cross the danger line.

games.title: Neon Autofire
games.subtitle: Run. Jump. Auto-blast. Survive.
games.description: Side-scrolling platformer shooter inspired by Mr. Autofire. Pixel-art cyberpunk cyborg hero (CraftPix), run and jump through a neon city, auto-fire on punks and yakuza thugs, level up, and survive the swarm.

games.title: Ironvale
games.subtitle: Run. Jump. Slash. Survive.
games.description: Medieval 2D platformer. Play a knight through the realm of Ironvale — leap platforms, sword-slash slimes and bandits, collect gold XP, and pick blessings as waves grow harder.

games.title: Bottle Sort
games.subtitle: Pour. Match. Sort every bottle.
games.description: Classic water-sort puzzle with neon glass bottles. Tap to pour glowing liquids until every bottle is a solid color. Levels randomize bottle count and colors — early boards are cozy, later ones get wild.

games.title: Maze Adventure
games.subtitle: Find the way. Have fun.
games.description: Guide a cute explorer through colorful toy mazes. Every level is procedurally generated — Easy for little kids, up to Very Hard for big challenges. No lives, no fail screens, just explore and reach the star.

games.title: Animal Tap Zoo
games.subtitle: Tap · bounce · hear · celebrate
games.description: Find the Lion! Spoken prompts, wandering animals, hearts, treats, and big celebrations. Side-view cartoon zoo friends across Savanna, Pond, Farm, and Forest. Zero fail — made for ages 4–6.

games.title: Bubble Pop Garden
games.subtitle: Pop · sparkle · musical notes
games.description: Pop colorful garden bubbles with sparkles and musical notes. Free Play for little hands, or gentle Pop 10 / Color Hunt missions for bigger kids. Zero fail — made for ages 4–6.

games.title: Color Match Pond
games.subtitle: Drag · match · splash
games.description: Drag frogs, ducks, fish, and turtles onto matching lily pads. Soft color matching for ages 4–6 — wrong pads bounce home gently with a hint, never a fail screen.

games.title: Hide & Seek Rooms
games.subtitle: Peek · find · celebrate
games.description: Find hidden toys in cozy rooms — bedroom, kitchen, playground, and more. Soft sparkle hints if you’re stuck. Zero fail — made for ages 4–6.

games.title: Treasure Dig
games.subtitle: Dig · sparkle · celebrate
games.description: Tap sand tiles to dig up shells, stars, crabs, and coins. Soft beach treasure hunt for ages 4–6 — no bombs, no fail screens, sparkle hints if you’re stuck.

games.title: Shape Train
games.subtitle: Drag · match · choo-choo
games.description: Load circle, square, star, and more into matching train cars. Full train chugs away with a whistle. Soft shape matching for ages 4–6 — wrong drops bounce home gently.

games.title: Dress-Up Dino
games.subtitle: Tap · style · roar
games.description: Dress a friendly dino with hats, scarves, glasses, and spots. Save favorite outfits and show off with confetti. Creative free play for ages 4–6 — no fail screens.

games.title: Number Caterpillar
games.subtitle: Tap · count · grow
games.description: Tap numbers in order 1→2→3… and grow a friendly caterpillar. Finish the chain for a butterfly celebration. Soft counting fun for ages 4–6 — no fail screens.

games.title: Letter Picnic
games.subtitle: Find · munch · celebrate
games.description: Find the letter on a cozy picnic blanket — Find B! Spoken prompts, munch cheers, soft hints. Soft ABC fun for ages 4–6 — no fail screens.

games.title: Cozy Racers
games.subtitle: Steer · collect · celebrate
games.description: Steer a cute kart, pass friends, grab nitro, dodge oil. Soft bumps slow you down — longer races, real 1st-place wins for ages 4–6.
